sections.heading: How We Shortlisted Lightweight Camping Chairs
body: This draft evaluates chairs by packed size, price tier, support profile, stability expectations, and category fit.
Before publishing, an editor should verify specifications against manufacturer pages and remove any unsupported claim.

sections.heading: Buying Advice
body: Choose a lighter chair when packed size and carry weight matter. Choose a more supportive chair when camp comfort matters more than moving fast.
Avoid selecting by listed weight alone. Seat height, stability, packed shape, and setup complexity can matter as much as the headline weight.
